title: Solid model
caption: Complete uniform-shell CRM wingbox. This adaptation has 23,738 nodes, 25,055 quadrilateral shells and 242 property regions.

title: Finite element mesh
caption: The complete shell mesh. This model contains no bar or rod elements: the source stiffener effect is smeared into the shell properties.

title: Translucent structure
caption: Translucent shell surfaces reveal ribs and spar webs inside the closed box.

title: Property regions
caption: Property ID colors identify regions. The isotropic adaptation uses the same 20 mm thickness and material in every region; this view does not imply a varying thickness field.

title: Properties in Boxer
caption: Actual JFEM-Boxer interface with the imported source deck and its structural property display.

title: Structural constraints
caption: Source-deck constraints, including the root and side-of-body restraints. Constraints are obtained from the BDF, not inferred from the mode shapes.

title: Internal ribs and spars
caption: Skin property regions are hidden using the normal entity visibility controls. Remaining shells are rendered with their physical thickness.

title: Inboard structure
caption: Selected inboard spar-web and rib properties, with the skins hidden and 20 mm shell thickness shown. Other regions are hidden, not removed from the FE model.

title: Exploded property regions
caption: Normal Boxer property explosion, spread radially about the model centroid. This separation changes the view only.

title: Inboard mesh detail
caption: Selected spar-web and rib patches shown at their reference surfaces with element edges.
